name: existsUnique_section
statement: x.IsCompatible) (hY : J.CoversTop Y) (hF : IsSheaf J F) : ∃! (s : F.sections), ∀ (i : I), s.1 (Opposite.op (Y i)) = x i

children.name: hs
children.type: ∀ {X : C} (i : I) (f : X ⟶ Y i), s X = F.map f.op (x i)

children.name: hs'
children.type: ∀ {W X : C} (a : W ⟶ X) (i : I) (_ : W ⟶ Y i), F.map a.op (s X) = s W
